notes: This contract records portable C++ TCK checks for timestamped federation save and restore with queued delivery. The tests use only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. The ordinary timestamped case covers queued interaction recovery, Flush Queue delivery, and retraction. The regional cases add standard region setup, conveyed-region metadata, and default-region delivery. No provider-specific save format, registry, transport, header, or persistence implementation is required.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped federation save/restore, time advance, Flush Queue, and retraction services with FederateAmbassador save/restore and timestamped delivery callbacks
